title: Trip Plan
description: Returned by the Claude Project for one Plan Request and imported by the app. Exactly one structured part (the Packing List); everything else is free-form titled Plan Sections rendered as-is.

packingList.description: Checkable items. The app adds and persists the checked state locally; the Project never sends it.

assignedTo.description: Name of the Traveller responsible, or null for shared/unassigned.

sections.description: Titled free-form sections (itinerary, dining, logistics, ...). Body is plain text / markdown, rendered as-is and never interpreted.
